7:6R0Not used
5:4LODIV_BUF_CURRENT_TX[1:0]1 (0x01)R/WAdjusts current TX LO buffer (input to PA). The value to use in this field is given by the SmartRF Studio software [5].
3R0Not used
2:0PA_POWER[2:0]0 (0x00)R/WSelects PA power setting. This value is an index to the PATABLE, which can be programmed with up to 8 different PA settings. In OOK/ASK mode, this selects the PATABLE index to use when transmitting a '1'. PATABLE index zero is used in OOK/ASK when transmitting a '0'. The PATABLE settings from index '0' to the PA_POWER value are used for ASK TX shaping, and for power ramp-up/ramp-down at the start/end of transmission in all TX modulation formats.
